Fine-map QTL or GWAS markers

Source: R/fineMap.R
fineMap.Rd

Performs single-QTL fine mapping in a window around each significant QTL (for qtlAim models) or marker (for gwasAim models) found in a fitted model. Both univariate and multivariate (Trait) models are supported.

For qtlAim models a dense inferred-marker grid is constructed inside the window using the Haldane-map weight approach of primeCross, irrespective of the type or infer argument originally passed to primeCross(). Each grid position is tested as a fixed effect in turn, with all other detected QTL effects held in the model.

For gwasAim models the window is defined around the significant marker (in cM) and all panel markers within the window are tested individually; no inferred midpoints are added.

For multivariate models, QTL that were retained as main effects after Wald pruning are scanned using the same single-df z-ratio as the univariate case. QTL retained as Trait-interaction effects are scanned by substituting Trait:candidate for Trait:QTL and computing a joint Wald statistic across all non-aliased interaction coefficients via an internal Wald test; the LOD score is derived as \(\chi^2 / (2 \log 10)\), consistent with the univariate formula.

Usage

fineMap(
  object,
  genObj,
  qtl = NULL,
  window = 50,
  step = 2,
  exclusion.window = 20,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted object of class "qtlAim" or "gwasAim".

genObj

The wgCross or wgPanel object used in the analysis, produced by primeCross or primePanel.

qtl

Character vector of QTL / marker keys to fine-map, using the internal "Chr.<chr>.<idx>" format stored in object$QTL$qtl. If NULL (default) all detected QTL / markers are fine-mapped.

window

Numeric scalar. Half-width of the fine-mapping window in cM. Default 50.

step

Numeric scalar. cM step size for the inferred-marker grid. Only used for qtlAim models. Smaller values give finer resolution at the cost of more model refits. Default 2.

exclusion.window

Numeric scalar. cM exclusion zone around other (non-target) detected QTL during each scan. Default 20.

...

Additional arguments passed to update.asreml, e.g.\ na.action = na.method(x = "include").

Value

An object of class "fineMap": a named list with one element per fine-mapped QTL. Each element is a data frame with columns:

mark

Name of the inferred grid point or panel marker.

dist

cM position on the chromosome.

pvalue

Two-tailed p-value from the z-ratio test.

LOD

LOD score derived from the z-ratio.

The list has attribute "qtl.key" recording the original QTL key names, and attribute "type" recording "qtlAim" or "gwasAim". Each per-QTL data frame additionally carries two attributes: "qtl_pos" (numeric, the cM position of the original QTL / marker used as the window centre) and "clipped" (logical, TRUE if the window was truncated at a chromosome boundary).
